notes: The ASV's own margin gives the literal *according to the gift of his hand*; the running text recasts the whole construct chain as *is able*, in which no English word realizes either noun's lexeme, so `מַתְּנַת יָד` is `noncompositional` with the construction-supplied copula inside it, while the suffix keeps the subject pronoun it is realized by (rules 18, 40).
*shall give* is `added`: the Hebrew clause is verbless and writes no verb for it (rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause).
The supplied distributive *every* joins `אִישׁ` under rule 15, since no `אֶחָד`, `כֹּל` or article stands in the clause to license it.
